answer: Launching fake identities costs a full stake per persona plus forfeiture on any disputed voyage, so a farmer swarming the network with N sockpuppets burns N stakes prior to earning trust, making mass deception economically irrational. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
